Round123C.genuine_weighted_adjoint_pairing.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (nu : Measure (C K))

Round123C.genuine_weighted_bounded_adjoint.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (mu : Measure (C K))
  (alpha s : ℝ) [SFinite (weightedMeasure K mu alpha s)] (phi : C K → ℂ)

  (hA :
    ∀ (h : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 (weightedMeasure K mu alpha s))),
      ∀ᵐ (x : C K) ∂weightedMeasure K mu alpha s,
        ↑↑(A h) x = ∫ (y : C K), weightedKernel K alpha s phi x y * ↑↑h y ∂weightedMeasure K mu alpha s)
  (hB :
    ∀ (f : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 (weightedMeasure K mu alpha s))),
      ∀ᵐ (y : C K) ∂weightedMeasure K mu alpha s,
        ↑↑(B f) y =
          ∫ (x : C K),
            ↑(density K alpha s x / density K alpha s y) * weightedKernel K alpha s (reflected K phi) y x *
              ↑↑f x ∂weightedMeasure K mu alpha s)
  (hfub :
    ∀ (f h : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 (weightedMeasure K mu alpha s))),
      Integrable (fun p => star (↑↑f p.1) * (weightedKernel K alpha s phi p.1 p.2 * ↑↑h p.2))
        ((weightedMeasure K mu alpha s).prod (weightedMeasure K mu alpha s))) :
